title: Focus on the gap during your daily activities
caption:
You don't need a quiet room for this one. Eating, walking, working, keep a part of your attention in the gap between two breaths.

Technique 6 of 112. Life becomes a drama. You play your role fully, and still you know who you are.

Save this and try it on your next walk.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.
